newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil firms with futures and stronger diffs.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil firms with futures and stronger diffs.

text.p: NWE gas oil edged higher on Thursday in line with benchmark IPE gas oil futures gains and slightly firmer premiums, traders said.
July IPE gas oil closed $1.50 higher at $161.25 a tonne.

Heating oil barge premiums were slightly healthier with small parcels trading at July IPE flat for promptish delivery. Premiums were talked at around July IPE -25 cents/+25 cents fob ARA for prompt delivery and July IPE flat/+50-75 cents for first half July.
"There's been a bit more activity here today but it's still pretty dull," said one trader.
The diesel market was very quiet with differentials talked around July IPE +$5.50/+$6.50 fob ARA.
On the cargo front, EN590 cargoes were assessed around the July IPE +$6.0/+$7.0 level. Some traders said prices should firm over July with less material seen coming out of the Mediterranean.
"Supply will still be pretty healthy because the refineries here are still producing a fair amount but it will help even if there are two or three fewer Med cargoes," one trader said.
Heating oil cargoes were assessed around the July IPE flat/+50 cif NWE level.
